subject: Web Development
title: DNS: The Web's Phone Book
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on DNS: The Web's Phone Book.

hook.text: Computers use numbers to find each other. Humans prefer names like google.com.

buildup.text: DNS translates domain names into IP addresses so browsers know where to connect.

discovery.text: Your browser caches DNS results so it doesn't ask again for sites you visit often.

twist.text: A slow DNS server can add hundreds of milliseconds before a page even starts loading.

climax.text: DNS prefetching lets browsers resolve names in advance, shaving time off future clicks.

punchline.text: Every website visit starts with a name lookup.
